# Manuscript Guided Sample


This sample is designed to teach the normal workflow: **Write → Format → Add → Publish**. Edit any paragraph in the Markdown source and watch the preview update.


## 1. Write


Use Markdown headings, emphasis, links, lists, tables, code, and page breaks. Open the command palette with **Ctrl/Cmd+K** to discover available actions.


- Keep the source readable.
- Use the Outline to navigate long documents.
- Use Search for project-level edits.


## 2. Format


Open **Format** in the workflow bar. The Inspector is deliberately split into **Setup** (document rules), **Style** (appearance), and **Layout** (page geometry), so each control has one clear home.


## 3. Add


| Feature | Where to find it |
|---|---|
| Images | Left rail → Media |
| References | Left rail → References |
| Equations | Insert / command palette |
| Tables | Toolbar or Insert |


::: note {title="Publishing note"}
Advanced controls remain available, but the most common controls are shown first. Expand an Inspector section only when you need it.
:::


$$ {#eq-sample}
E = mc^2
$$


## 4. Publish


Switch to **Publish**. Inspect paginated pages, open the page navigator, run Preflight, resolve blocking diagnostics, and then choose **Print / Save as PDF**.
